newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 11 trln rbls T-bills Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 11 trln rbls T-bills Nov 20.

text.p: The Russian finance ministry will auction eight trillion roubles of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22059) and three trillion roubles of a new tranche of six-month bills (series 22044) on November 20, the central bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the auctions follow:
Full details of the new issue:
NOTE - Although the bill runs for more than nine months, it is officially classified as six-month paper.
Full details of the new tranche:
The issue yielded an average 106.12 percent when it was auctioned. The paper closed at 46.14 percent on Tuesday.
On November 20, the finance ministry will also repay about 6.33 trillion roubles in maturing three-month bills (series 21068).
